{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''A Fleebog emissary''' joined [[Unidentified Fleebog emissary 1|four]] [[Unidentified Fleebog emissary 2|fellow]] [[Unidentified Fleebog emissary 3|Fleebogs]] on a trip to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[City/Legends|village]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree]] to kidnap the Ewok [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]]<ref name="E11">[[Ewoks (1985) 11|''Ewoks'' (1985) 11]]</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' places the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated television series in 3.5 ABY but makes no mention of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] comic book series. Nevertheless, as the character designs in the comic book are identical to those of the the first season of the ''Ewoks'' television show, the comic book stories must take place around the same time as the animated cartoon.</ref> The Fleebog delegation shrank the princess to the size of a member of the [[Fleebog]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with a [[damsel flower]] and brought the princess to their lair to help them fight a creature known as the [[ra-lugg]].<ref name="E11" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Fleebog species appears in [[Ewoks (1985) 11|''Ewoks'' 11]], which was written by [[David Manak|Dave Manak]] and first published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[1987]]. The illustrations, by [[Warren Kremer]], depict a party of four Fleebogs kidnapping the princess; however, Manak provides no distinguishing characteristics for the characters, making them impossible to distinguish from one another.<ref name="E11" />
